purpose: Define source, unit, comparator, history, normalization, provenance, and scoring authority before a market feature can reach the regime rulebook.

quality.freshness_factor: 1 when fresh, 0 when stale, linear between thresholds
quality.provenance_rule: observed or transparent derived features may score; proxy, context-only, unavailable, or planned features may not score

hl_mark_price_usd.decision_role: Base measurement used to derive returns; an absolute price is not a direction score.
caveats: Current mark price is retained as a base measurement and is the source series for the one-hour return comparator; the price itself remains ineligible to score.

hl_return_1h_pct.source: Hyperliquid mark-price observations; across a gap in them, the Hyperliquid 1-minute candle close
hl_return_1h_pct.comparator: mark price at or immediately before t minus 1 hour, rejected when the anchor lags the one-hour target by more than the configured tolerance; when no observed mark price qualifies, the close of the newest venue 1-minute candle that closed at or before t minus 1 hour, within the same tolerance
hl_return_1h_pct.decision_role: Directional price movement over the intraday decision horizon.
hl_return_1h_pct.missing_data: Feature unavailable; price/volatility block loses coverage.
caveats: Requires timestamp-aligned mark-price history; the derivation emits no value when neither an observed mark price nor a venue 1-minute candle close exists at or before t minus one hour within the tolerance.
A gap wider than the anchor tolerance in both the mark-price series and the venue candles suppresses the feature rather than widening the comparator window.

Since 1.8.1, when TradeSync observed no mark price at the target (the hour after an outage, or a market's first hour) the anchor is a venue candle close, the last trade of that minute, not the mark price. Each derivation records comparator.anchor_source (observed_mark_price or venue_candle_close) on the snapshot; the stored feature series does not carry it.

Measured 14-15 September over ten markets (5,037 candles, 15,453 returns; tools/return_anchor_candle_gap.py): candle close minus mark price median 1.6 bps absolute (p90 7.8; BTC 0.5, PUMP 2.7); one-hour return difference median 0.029 percentage points (p90 0.137); same sign 97.5% of the time.

hl_spread_bps.source: Hyperliquid l2Book best bid and best ask
hl_spread_bps.comparator: spread divided by the same-book midpoint
hl_spread_bps.missing_data: Liquidity block loses spread contribution and coverage.
caveats: Polling snapshots can miss brief spread spikes.

hl_depth_25bp_usd.source: Hyperliquid l2Book levels within 25 bps of midpoint
hl_depth_25bp_usd.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol and feature definition
hl_depth_25bp_usd.decision_role: More nearby two-sided depth improves liquidity suitability.
hl_depth_25bp_usd.missing_data: Liquidity block loses depth contribution and coverage.
caveats: Displayed orders may be cancelled and do not guarantee executable depth.

hl_buy_impact_5k_bps.source: Book walk over Hyperliquid l2Book asks for 5000 USD
hl_buy_impact_5k_bps.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol, side, and notional
hl_buy_impact_5k_bps.decision_role: Higher estimated buy impact reduces liquidity suitability.
hl_buy_impact_5k_bps.missing_data: Liquidity block loses impact contribution and coverage.
caveats: Current implementation models buy-side impact only and is an estimate, not a fill promise.

hl_funding_hourly_rate.comparator: rolling hourly funding history for the same contract
hl_funding_hourly_rate.decision_role: Crowding evidence whose sign must be interpreted with side, OI, and price—not as standalone direction.
hl_funding_hourly_rate.missing_data: Positioning block loses funding evidence and coverage.
caveats: Positive funding means longs pay shorts; it does not automatically mean price will fall.

hl_funding_apr_24h.source: Mean hourly Hyperliquid funding over 24 hours
hl_funding_apr_24h.decision_role: Human-readable simple annualization: mean hourly rate times 24 times 365.
caveats: Simple annualization is a rate comparison, not a realized or compounded return forecast.

hl_open_interest_4h_pct.source: Hyperliquid open interest converted to USD with mark price
hl_open_interest_4h_pct.comparator: earliest valid OI observation inside the prior 4-hour window
hl_open_interest_4h_pct.decision_role: Leverage build or unwind; direction requires price/funding context.
hl_open_interest_4h_pct.missing_data: Positioning block loses OI evidence and coverage.
caveats: USD OI changes with both contract quantity and mark price.

hl_volume_24h_usd.comparator: rolling history of the same rolling-24h field
hl_volume_24h_usd.decision_role: Participation intensity; high volume is not direction by itself.
hl_volume_24h_usd.missing_data: Price/volatility block loses activity evidence and coverage.
caveats: Current 5m, 1h, and 4h volume fields are estimates from 24h volume and are not admitted features.

hl_orderbook_imbalance_1pct.source: Hyperliquid l2Book bid and ask depth within 1 percent
hl_orderbook_imbalance_1pct.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol and depth band
hl_orderbook_imbalance_1pct.decision_role: Short-lived bid/ask depth asymmetry used only as supporting evidence.
hl_orderbook_imbalance_1pct.missing_data: Liquidity block loses imbalance contribution and coverage.
caveats: Order-book imbalance can be cancelled or spoofed and must not become a standalone signal.

hl_oracle_premium_bps.source: Hyperliquid markPx and oraclePx or the venue premium field
hl_oracle_premium_bps.comparator: Hyperliquid validator oracle price aligned to the mark observation
hl_oracle_premium_bps.decision_role: Perpetual-versus-oracle premium; not Coinbase premium and not independent spot demand.
hl_oracle_premium_bps.missing_data: Positioning block loses premium evidence and coverage.
caveats: Derived from aligned Hyperliquid markPx and oraclePx; it is not Coinbase premium and does not independently prove spot demand.

hl_liquidation_total_proxy_usd.decision_role: Legacy diagnostic only; cannot establish liquidation direction or score a playbook.
caveats: The current 50/50 long-short split is not observed market truth.

hl_direct_liquidation_flow.decision_role: Reserved for observed venue-supported liquidation events.
hl_direct_liquidation_flow.missing_data: Show unavailable; never substitute the OI proxy as observed direction.
caveats: No current public adapter supplies direct side-labelled liquidations.

hl_direct_cvd.source: Hyperliquid trades websocket, signed taker notional
hl_direct_cvd.comparator: signed taker notional over a rolling five-minute window
hl_direct_cvd.decision_role: Observed taker buy/sell flow; sustained aggressive buying is directional evidence.
hl_direct_cvd.missing_data: Show unavailable; never substitute candle or volume estimates.
caveats: Do not present candle or volume estimates as direct CVD.
Side convention B=aggressive buy, A=aggressive sell was determined empirically against the live order book on 2026-09-08; the venue does not document it.
Absent rather than zero until trades are observed, since zero is a real reading meaning balanced flow.

coinbase_premium_bps.source: Coinbase Exchange BTC/ETH/SOL-USD ticker mid versus the Hyperliquid mark
coinbase_premium_bps.comparator: Coinbase book mid minus Hyperliquid mark, over the mark, rejected when the two venues were sampled more than 10s apart
coinbase_premium_bps.decision_role: Spot demand above the perpetual is read as directional support. Admitted to scoring by operator decision on 2026-09-08; Coinbase remains a price reference and never a trading venue.
caveats: Coinbase is an external reference venue, not the trading venue. Hyperliquid remains the only venue TradeSync trades on.
Robust z-score is used because a premium spikes; an ordinary z-score would let one dislocation distort the baseline for a whole session.
Book mid is used rather than the last trade, so a single print cannot read as premium.
A premium is not computed when the two venues were sampled more than 10s apart; sampling lag would otherwise present as market structure.
CoinGecko aggregate spot context is not an equivalent replacement.

bitcoin_etf_net_flow_usd.source: No admitted free primary flow source
bitcoin_etf_net_flow_usd.comparator: Prior daily flows after publication timestamp
bitcoin_etf_net_flow_usd.decision_role: Slow context; cannot trigger a trade or create intraday direction alone.
caveats: Publication timing and later revisions must be stored to prevent look-ahead bias.

verified_external_event_risk.source: Future verified event registry with provenance and effective timestamps
verified_external_event_risk.decision_role: May create a risk cap; cannot assign bullish or bearish direction.
caveats: Event severity and market impact are distinct variables.

gdelt_news_tone.source: GDELT DOC 2.0 timelinetone: average tone of world news mentioning the coin, 15-minute buckets, newest closed bucket
gdelt_news_tone.comparator: GDELT article tone from -100 to +100 averaged per 15-minute bucket; the bucket still filling is skipped
gdelt_news_tone.decision_role: Recorded against outcomes so news tone can be tested as a directional input. Contributes nothing to any score until it earns a weight through measured skill (edge_evidence.positive_skill), which is an operator decision.
gdelt_news_tone.missing_data: Absent when GDELT has not answered for the coin within the last hour, or when no closed bucket exists.
caveats: Context only: this is somebody else's reading of the news, not something TradeSync measured on the venue.
GDELT limits requests to one every five seconds; the poller asks for one coin at a time on a fifteen-minute cycle.
Queries name the project, not the ticker, because NEAR, LINK and UNI are ordinary words.
A zero tone is a claim that the news was neutral; a missing reading is absent, never zero.
Attribution required by GDELT's terms: The GDELT Project, https://www.gdeltproject.org/

binance_funding_rate_8h.source: Binance USDT-M perpetual premiumIndex lastFundingRate for the same coin
binance_funding_rate_8h.comparator: The venue's last funding rate per 8-hour interval, as published
binance_funding_rate_8h.decision_role: Recorded so cross-venue positioning can be tested. Contributes nothing to any score until it earns a weight; Binance is a price and positioning reference, never a trading venue.
binance_funding_rate_8h.missing_data: Absent when Binance has not answered within ten minutes.
caveats: Binance is an external reference venue, not the trading venue. Hyperliquid remains the only venue TradeSync trades on.
Binance funding is per 8 hours; Hyperliquid's is hourly. Compare only after converting, which funding_spread_vs_binance_bps does.

binance_open_interest_usd.source: Binance USDT-M perpetual openInterest in contracts, converted at the venue's own mark
binance_open_interest_usd.comparator: Open interest in USD at the Binance mark at the time of the read
binance_open_interest_usd.decision_role: Context for how much of the wider market's positioning sits on the largest venue. Never scores on its own.
binance_open_interest_usd.missing_data: Absent when Binance has not answered within ten minutes.
caveats: USD open interest moves with both contract quantity and mark price.
Not comparable to Hyperliquid OI without stating which mark each was valued at.

funding_spread_vs_binance_bps.source: Hyperliquid hourly funding times eight, minus Binance 8-hour funding, in basis points
funding_spread_vs_binance_bps.comparator: Both venues per 8 hours; rejected when the two readings were more than 5 minutes apart
funding_spread_vs_binance_bps.decision_role: Positive means Hyperliquid longs are paying more than Binance longs: the Hyperliquid crowd is more one-sidedly long than the wider market's. A directional candidate, recorded first; it can score only after measured skill and an operator decision.
funding_spread_vs_binance_bps.missing_data: Absent when either venue's funding is missing or the readings were not aligned.
caveats: A spread is not a prediction; funding can stay skewed for days.
Sampling skew is bounded at 5 minutes so a slow poll cannot present as market structure.

hl_resting_liquidity_imbalance.source: Hyperliquid l2Book aggregated to 3 significant figures: resting bid against ask notional within 5% of price
hl_resting_liquidity_imbalance.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol
hl_resting_liquidity_imbalance.decision_role: Context: which side holds more resting liquidity near price. Weighted only after it earns measured, held-out skill.
hl_resting_liquidity_imbalance.missing_data: The liquidity block loses this context; nothing else changes.
caveats: Displayed orders can be cancelled or spoofed; resting size is not executable depth.
Three significant figures cover a different share of price in each market.

hl_bid_wall_distance_bps.source: Hyperliquid l2Book aggregated to 3 significant figures: distance to the largest resting bid within 5% below price
hl_bid_wall_distance_bps.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol
hl_bid_wall_distance_bps.decision_role: Context: where the nearest large resting bid sits, for levels and stops.
hl_bid_wall_distance_bps.missing_data: No wall is reported below price.
caveats: Displayed orders can be cancelled or spoofed; resting size is not executable depth.
Three significant figures cover a different share of price in each market.

hl_ask_wall_distance_bps.source: Hyperliquid l2Book aggregated to 3 significant figures: distance to the largest resting ask within 5% above price
hl_ask_wall_distance_bps.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol
hl_ask_wall_distance_bps.decision_role: Context: where the nearest large resting ask sits, for levels and targets.
hl_ask_wall_distance_bps.missing_data: No wall is reported above price.
caveats: Displayed orders can be cancelled or spoofed; resting size is not executable depth.
Three significant figures cover a different share of price in each market.

cex_liquidations_net_1h_usd.source: Liquidations received from Bybit (BTC, ETH, SOL) and Binance USDT-M in the last hour: long minus short notional
cex_liquidations_net_1h_usd.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol
cex_liquidations_net_1h_usd.decision_role: Context: whether longs or shorts were being forced out on other venues in the last hour.
cex_liquidations_net_1h_usd.missing_data: No liquidation tally is available; the absence is not a zero.
caveats: Other venues' liquidations, not Hyperliquid's.
Binance sends at most one liquidation per market per second, so bursts are undercounted.

liq_map_skew_3pct.source: Estimated liquidation map: short levels within 3% above price against long levels within 3% below
liq_map_skew_3pct.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol
liq_map_skew_3pct.decision_role: Context: which side holds more estimated forced-out positions near price. A proxy, so it cannot score.
liq_map_skew_3pct.missing_data: The positioning block loses this context.
caveats: An estimate from Binance open-interest changes and an assumed leverage mix, not observed orders or Hyperliquid positions.
Binance publishes about 30 days of open-interest history; older positions are not seen.

liq_map_largest_above_pct.source: Estimated liquidation map: distance to the largest estimated short-liquidation cluster above price
liq_map_largest_above_pct.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol
liq_map_largest_above_pct.decision_role: Context: a level where estimated short liquidations cluster.
liq_map_largest_above_pct.missing_data: No cluster above price is reported.
caveats: An estimate from Binance open-interest changes and an assumed leverage mix, not observed orders or Hyperliquid positions.
Binance publishes about 30 days of open-interest history; older positions are not seen.

liq_map_largest_below_pct.source: Estimated liquidation map: distance to the largest estimated long-liquidation cluster below price
liq_map_largest_below_pct.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol
liq_map_largest_below_pct.decision_role: Context: a level where estimated long liquidations cluster.
liq_map_largest_below_pct.missing_data: No cluster below price is reported.
caveats: An estimate from Binance open-interest changes and an assumed leverage mix, not observed orders or Hyperliquid positions.
Binance publishes about 30 days of open-interest history; older positions are not seen.
